status: FROZEN - changes require a new protocol_version and owner approval

task.unit_of_independence: provenance group (fabrics sharing a provenance_group, source product/lot or evidence product identifier)
task.ground_truth: Phase 4 VERIFIED fabrics only (verification policy v2: accepted evidence + independent second review). CottonFabricImageBD labels are never ground truth.

readiness_gates.R7_definition: adjacent_band_distance: a fabric is at boundary risk iff the distance from its verified cotton % to the nearest OTHER band, dist(c,[lo,hi]) = max(lo-c, 0, c-hi), is <= the distance; edges facing an empty gap or the physical limits 0/100 do not count
readiness_gates.R8_embedding_model: ImageNet ResNet-50 IMAGENET1K_V2, cached weights only (never downloaded); flags for human review, never merges

training_reference_recipe.pretrained: ImageNet (downloaded only when real-data training is approved)

model_selection_rule: simplest model whose paired balanced-accuracy difference to the best has a 95% CI including 0; prefer lighter architectures when equivalent

metrics.primary_level: fabric (mean of image probabilities per fabric)

changes: R7 redefined as distance to the nearest adjacent band (v1.0 measured every endpoint, so the 2-point-wide Very high band could never pass); 3-point distance and 20 % share unchanged
R8 adds a cached ImageNet ResNet-50 embedding similarity flag (threshold 0.85) alongside the colour/structure flag; both only trigger human review
